UI Alchemy: Overcoming Asset Transparency with CSS Masks Code Alchemy
By Hadyan Ahmad
💻

The Insight

Solusi teknis untuk masalah transparansi asset logo pada tema Dark Mode menggunakan CSS masking.

The Solution Path

Problem: PNG logos with white backgrounds failed in Dark Mode. Investigation: CSS filter vs SVG mask. Discovery: mask-image with clean alpha channel is the most robust method. Solution: Used ImageMagick to threshold and extract alpha masks for the Hoshi logo.

Architecture: Static Manifestation with Dynamic Roots Code Alchemy
By Alkhawarizmi Zaid
